metadata.title: Soft-Constraint Quadratic Programming: Methods, Contracts, and Negative Timing Results
metadata.description:
Soft constraints price selected operating departures while preserving physical hard limits. This technical report describes the implemented quadratic-programming system, seven numerical paths, eighteen versioned data contracts, original physical units, local execution and independently evaluated results. It derives explicit slack lifting, generalized projection, side-specific DAQP weights, fixed FlexQP and ElastiQP constructions, side-specific separable interval updates and directional disjoint group-peak updates, with compatibility and convergence limits. Fifteen model cases exercise scalar semantics, mixed hard and soft policy, sparse structure, predictive control and building energy. The original registered computation contains 456 seeded instances: its primary comprises 24 distinct problems and 168 paired repetitions, with median relative cold end-to-end reduction 0.499839% and 95% seed-cluster interval [-3.291967%,3.944835%]. The separate grouped computation retains all 210 inputs and 7770 raw observations. Its complete 144-member held-out primary score is -212.449875%, with limits [-225.336618%,-192.873759%] and nine failed pairs retained. Neither registered ten-percent timing improvement is established. Native equations, algorithms, schema restrictions, vector figures, complete result populations and primary references distinguish mathematical equivalence from computational advantage. The evidence concerns synthetic models on one host and does not establish operational safety, field benefit or algorithmic priority.

Editable LaTeX sources and code: CAOS_SoftQP. Native engine: CAOS_SoftQP_Engine. Complete grouped evidence: dataset.
